description: Use this to answer “where can I play tennis, pickleball or padel in <city>?”. It searches courts in a covered city, metro area or around a point: pass 'city' (e.g. 'Austin, TX', 'Long Beach', 'Lisbon', 'Los Angeles area'; add 'country' if the name is ambiguous) or 'lat'+'lon'+'radius_km'. Each result is a venue (courts within 70 m are merged) with number of courts, surface, lighting, access, fee, the nearest park, school or street ('near'), a Google Maps link ('maps_url') and the source. Filters are strict: a court passes only if the property is mapped; if fewer than 3 courts match and others were left out only because a property is unmapped, they are added and marked 'matched_unknown'. If no court of the requested sport (pickleball, padel) is mapped, the nearest tennis courts are returned in 'alternatives'. Data comes from OpenStreetMap (ODbL), is often incomplete, and every answer carries the data date and attribution.

city.description: A covered city, e.g. 'Austin, TX', 'Long Beach' or 'Tbilisi', or a whole metro area, e.g. 'Los Angeles area' (all of Los Angeles and Orange counties) or 'New York area'. See list_coverage.

country.description: Country name or ISO code, e.g. 'Georgia', 'GE', 'US'. Use it when the same city name exists in several countries; with lat/lon it limits the search to that country. Distances are in miles for the US and metres/kilometres elsewhere (distance_km is always given).

free.description: Only courts mapped as free of charge (fee=no).

lat.description: Latitude of the search point (use with lon).

lon.description: Longitude of the search point (use with lat).

match_unknown.description: Also return courts where a filtered property is not mapped (unknown).

min_courts.description: Minimum number of courts at the venue.

open_to_public.description: Only courts open to everyone. Returns courts mapped as public, free of charge or inside a park (open_to_public yes) and courts with no restriction mapped (open_to_public probably, with a note). Clubs, private courts and school grounds are excluded.

sport.description: Sport: tennis, padel or pickleball. Omit for any.
